title: alarm sound
body: Can anyone tell me if there is a way to reduce the volume of alarms??? I looked everywhere and the only thing I can see is high or medium or ASCENDING. How about implement a low or selectable option?? during the night while sleeping next to a spouse or a child it's insanely loud, my neighbor can ear it. Any help please???

comments.body:
You can choose a custom file for your alerts.

Choose something with low volume, then the total volume will not be too strong.

I appreciate your reply and suggestion but I really don't think it's a good
one. After so many people are asking for a low / be able to adjust volume
within the app I don't think we should be looking and testing sound files
too see if they fit the volume we need.

Just to let you know what I use to modify the volume of XDRIP alarms is
Samsung sound assistant. It can lower the volume of specific apps. I don't
know if that works for you but give it a try
